seo.title: GetUsRanked — Web Design & Search Engine / AI Optimization Agency
seo.description: GetUsRanked builds WordPress and Shopify sites with SEO and AI-search visibility baked in from day one, not bolted on after launch.

hero.heading: We build sites that actually get found.
hero.subheading: WordPress and Shopify sites, built with SEO and AI-search visibility baked in from day one, not bolted on after launch.

howWeThink.heading: Design that ranks, not just looks good

items.title: Design that ranks, not just looks good
items.desc: A beautiful site nobody finds is a beautiful waste of money. Every build starts with SEO and AI-search visibility as a requirement, not an afterthought.

items.title: Direct access, not account managers
items.desc: You work with the person actually building your site. No hand-offs, no junior teams, no layers between you and the work.

items.title: Built for how people search now
items.desc: Google isn't the only front door anymore. We set your site up for AI answer engines too — ChatGPT, Perplexity — so your business shows up wherever people are actually asking.

process.heading: Four steps. Built right from day one.

steps.label: Audit & Strategy
steps.title: Audit & Strategy
steps.desc: We start by understanding your customers, your competitors, and what's actually broken, before a single page gets designed.

steps.label: Design & Build
steps.title: Design & Build
steps.desc: Your site gets designed and built, WordPress or Shopify, with SEO structure and technical foundations built in from the first line of code.

steps.label: Launch & Optimize
steps.title: Launch & Optimize
steps.desc: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, and AI-search setup happen before launch. Not as a "phase two" you get upsold into later.

steps.label: Grow
steps.title: Grow
steps.desc: Once you're live, an optional monthly retainer keeps your rankings moving and keeps you visible as search itself keeps changing.

whyUs.eyebrow: Why This, Not a Bigger Agency
whyUs.heading: Honest work, direct focus, no overhead

pillars.title: Founder-led, every project
pillars.desc: One person, full attention. Not spread across forty accounts.

pillars.title: Built in the open
pillars.desc: Our own site's SEO growth is tracked and visible — not a claim, a live example.

pillars.title: Priced for the work, not the overhead
pillars.desc: No office lease or account-management layer baked into your invoice. You're paying for the build, not the agency's rent.

credibility.heading: We're new, and we're not going to pretend otherwise.
credibility.body: Instead of faking testimonials, we point you to our own site, live and rankable, as proof of how we work. Every client right now gets more of our actual attention than they'd get once we're bigger. That won't stay true forever, so it's worth taking advantage of now.
